title: Size-safe ReviewKernel dispatch for large reviews
summary: Decouple unbounded canonical evidence and dashboards from deterministic <=16 KiB producer views using immutable storage, verified reference-first projection, complete inline provenance, slot conservation, and fail-closed collection.

current_state.summary: ReviewKernel already owns immutable envelopes, content-addressed artifacts, section references, scoped v2 views, leases, and provenance-bound results. Requirements and impact can be referenced, but other sections remain copied inline and create_scoped_view raises after exceeding 16 KiB, preventing routed lens dispatch. Dashboard rendering is downstream of canonical collection.

alternatives.name: Deterministic reference-first section projection
alternatives.description: Extend the incumbent immutable artifact store and scoped-view boundary with budgeted section projection and verified resolution.

gains: Bounded views independent of canonical/dashboard size
costs: Resolver checks at dispatch and collection
tradeoffs.revisit_when: All supported transports guarantee a materially larger bounded payload and duplication is negligible.

alternatives.name: Raise or remove the view limit
alternatives.description: Keep copying scoped context and rely on provider context windows.

tradeoffs.revisit_when: Every producer transport enforces the same substantially larger minimum context.

alternatives.name: Paginate each lens
alternatives.description: Issue multiple page leases for one lens and merge partial verdicts.

tradeoffs.revisit_when: A lens demonstrably requires exhaustive sequential reading rather than targeted verified resolution.

decision: Extend the existing ReviewKernel artifact/provenance boundary. Reserve a complete inline identity spine, deterministically inline lens-relevant context that fits, reference overflow once, inventory every omission, verify before dispatch and collection, and conserve routed slots. Dashboard projection remains downstream and independent.

contracts.description: Conserves every non-zero routed slot through preparation, dispatch, and collection or returns a named fail-closed error.
Versioned v3 canonical <=16 KiB producer view with mandatory inline provenance, deterministic context projection, and explicit omission inventory.
Versioned v2 portable target/revision-bound immutable section reference verified by digest, length, semantic fingerprint, authorization, and canonical store location.
Dashboard consumes canonical collected state only; size and pagination cannot affect review semantics.

acceptance_map.criterion: Canonical envelopes, evidence sets, and dashboards substantially above 16 KiB dispatch the same routed slot set as equivalent small inputs.
acceptance_map.validation: Integration test parameterizes fitting and 4 MiB canonical/dashboard fixtures and asserts identical non-zero routed, prepared, and dispatched slot ids.

acceptance_map.criterion: Every serialized producer view remains within its configured byte budget at boundary and multi-megabyte sizes.
acceptance_map.validation: Boundary test serializes 16 KiB-edge and 8 MiB inputs and asserts each dispatch payload is <=16384 canonical UTF-8 bytes.

acceptance_map.criterion: Mandatory target, revision, routing, lens, slot, lease, schema, producer, and integrity identities remain inline.
acceptance_map.validation: Schema pressure test asserts all ten identity classes remain inline and covered by the view fingerprint.

acceptance_map.criterion: Overflow content is stored once and represented by stable target-bound digest-verified references.
acceptance_map.validation: Project repeated overflow into 26 slots; assert one artifact per unique digest and stable target-bound references.

acceptance_map.criterion: Missing, stale, mismatched, unauthorized, traversal, symlink-escape, and mutated references fail closed.
acceptance_map.validation: Parameterized resolver test exercises all seven rejection classes before dispatch and collection and expects named errors with no producer/result.

acceptance_map.criterion: Selected lens count greater than zero cannot become a successful zero-slot review.
acceptance_map.validation: Route a lens then inject preparation failure; assert slot-conservation error rather than success with zero slots.

acceptance_map.criterion: Dashboard size and pagination do not affect routing, leasing, dispatch, collection, findings, or gate values.
acceptance_map.validation: Render one collection at 1, 10, and 100 pages; assert identical routing, leases, results, findings, and gate fingerprint.

acceptance_map.criterion: Pinned inputs produce deterministic view fingerprints and reference manifests regardless of input ordering.
acceptance_map.validation: Shuffle sections/files/symbols 100 times; assert byte-identical views, manifests, and fingerprints.

acceptance_map.criterion: Lens-relevant context survives budget pressure and omitted optional material is explicitly inventoried.
acceptance_map.validation: Per-lens pressure fixtures assert relevant summaries inline and each non-inline section has reason, bytes, digest, and resolvable reference.

acceptance_map.criterion: Collection rejects mismatched view, reference manifest, lease, target, producer, revision, or slot.
acceptance_map.validation: Collection test independently tampers all seven identities and asserts rejection before canonical publication.

acceptance_map.criterion: Small fitting reviews retain compatible routing, evidence, findings, and gate behavior.
acceptance_map.validation: Golden fitting fixtures run through v3 and assert equivalent routing, evidence semantics, findings, and gates.

acceptance_map.criterion: Preparation stores one governed copy per unique overflow artifact and aggregate inline bytes remain bounded by slot budgets.
acceptance_map.validation: 26-lens 8 MiB load fixture asserts unique artifact count and aggregate inline bytes <=16384 times prepared slots.

risks.risk: Resolution crosses target or store boundaries.
risks.mitigation: Derive path from kind/fingerprint; bind target/revision; reject paths, traversal, symlinks, aliases, and authorization mismatch.
Reserve mandatory relevance summaries first and require a complete resolvable omission inventory.

risks.risk: Preparation failure is mistaken for no selected work.
risks.mitigation: Enforce selected/prepared/dispatched/collected conservation with a named fail-closed error.

risks.risk: Dashboard presentation leaks into review semantics.
risks.mitigation: Accept only canonical collection fingerprint as dashboard input and test size/page independence.
Keep v2 reader/collector until active leases expire; v3 is additive and immutable.

failure_modes.recovery: ReviewKernel owner stops before dispatch with review_scoped_view_budget_impossible; retry follows contract/policy correction.

failure_modes.mode: Artifact is missing, altered, stale, or unauthorized.
failure_modes.detection: review_reference_verify reports safe digest and reason.
failure_modes.recovery: Resolver stops immediately; operator restores the pinned artifact or restarts from the sealed envelope.
ReviewKernel aborts before publication and retries the named slot from its pinned envelope.

failure_modes.detection: review_reference_verify and review_slot_conservation report the identity.
failure_modes.recovery: Collector rejects without advancing revision; producer is re-leased from the same pinned view.

failure_modes.detection: review_dashboard_projection reports render failure after collection.
failure_modes.recovery: Dashboard owner retries or paginates; canonical findings and gate stay sealed.

signals: review_projection: canonical_bytes, inline_bytes, referenced_bytes, omission_count, view_fingerprint
review_reference_verify: kind, safe digest, outcome, reason
review_slot_conservation: selected, prepared, dispatched, collected counts and slot fingerprints
review_dashboard_projection: canonical fingerprint, rendered bytes, pages, semantic fingerprint
alerts: Block when a producer view exceeds 16384 bytes.
Block when non-zero selected differs from prepared, dispatched, or collected.
Alert on dashboard render failure without changing canonical gate state.

rollout.strategy: Add v2 reference and v3 scoped-view contracts behind TASKPLANE_REFERENCE_FIRST_VIEWS; dual-evaluate fitting fixtures; enable large reviews; then make v3 authoritative while retaining v2 readers for active leases.
rollout.rollback: Disable new v3 preparation, continue resolving/collecting issued v3 leases, and resume v2 for new reviews. Artifacts are immutable/additive; no migration is reversed.

lens_evidence.evidence: Grounded in incumbent immutable artifacts and the actual overflow failure; compared extension, limit removal, and pagination; mapped all 12 criteria to named contracts and executable bounds/integrity/metamorphic tests; matched failures to declared signals and bounded actors; preserved additive rollback; no new service, migration, unresolved sequencing decision, or silent debt.
